name: Goiás
summary: Eight alternating green and yellow horizontal stripes with a blue canton holding five white stars of the Southern Cross.
origin: Joaquim Bonifácio de Siqueira created the flag, adopted by Law No. 650 on 30 July 1919.

colors.name: Green
colors.meaning: The House of Braganza of Emperor Pedro I.

colors.name: Yellow
colors.meaning: The House of Habsburg of Empress Maria Leopoldina.

symbols.name: Southern Cross
symbols.meaning: The constellation behind Brazil's early names, Ilha de Vera Cruz and Terra de Santa Cruz.

facts: Tocantins was split from northern Goiás in 1988.
Goiânia, the capital, is a planned city founded in 1933.
clues: Green and yellow stripes with the Southern Cross in a blue canton.
Its colours honour an emperor and empress.
